model_numbers: IN2011 (IN); no BR SKU (OnePlus never sold officially in Brazil)
notes: Discontinued; used market only in 2026. Qualifies via official Android 11/12/13 (OxygenOS 13) upgrades. UW 116deg f/2.2 confirmed (GSMArena).
caveats: 116deg advertised UW is in the marginal 112-117 band - computed dFOV could land near the 110deg floor. OxygenOS 12 blocked ALL third-party access to aux cameras (XDA/AndroidPolice, Dec 2021); the documented C.44 restore covered only the 9/9 Pro, and the 8-series' final OOS13 aux-access state is unconfirmed - runtime CONTROL_ZOOM_RATIO/separate-ID probe is decisive. Pre-OOS12, OnePlus exposed aux IDs as separate physical cameras (possibly package-whitelisted), not via zoom-ratio <1.0 on ID 0. SD865 HEVC encoder reliable (Qualcomm 8-series, CBR documented). ARCore certified. Android 13 is final OS; 2020 hardware, used-market only.

notes: Advertised 150deg fisheye-capable ultrawide; default UW capture mode is ~110deg (corrected). Stable OxygenOS 15 (Android 15) confirmed rolled out (oxygenupdater). Discontinued.
caveats: Raw 150deg fisheye optics clear the dFOV floor with huge margin IF reachable, but: (a) launched ON the OOS12/ColorOS-base aux-camera blockade with no documented restore for the 10-series - third-party UW access unconfirmed, runtime probe decisive; (b) severe fisheye distortion at full FOV (OEM default corrects to ~110deg) - captured frames will be heavily distorted at the edges, a training-data quality consideration even if the gate passes. SD 8 Gen 1 encoder reliable but the SoC is the batch's worst thermal actor - 1080p30 encode is light, 25-min sustain expected yet unverified. ARCore certified.

notes: India-centric (sibling of Nord 2T / Ace). 150W 'Endurance Edition' variant existed. OxygenOS 15 (Android 15) eligibility confirmed (beta Feb 2025). Discontinued.
caveats: Two independent significant unknowns. (1) Encoder: Dimensity 8000-family is MIXED per SoC intel - MTK encoders ignore frame timestamps (WebRTC forces FRAMERATE_ADJUSTMENT) and CBR honoring must be verified via isBitrateModeSupported(CBR), not configure() silence; no positive 1080p30 HEVC CBR evidence for D8100 specifically. (2) Ultrawide: 120deg IMX355 on paper, but launched on the OOS12/ColorOS-base aux blockade with no restore evidence for this model - third-party reachability unconfirmed. ARCore certified (added July 2022, AndroidPolice - corrects the recon snapshot's absence), so IMU 100Hz is solid; timestamp source likely REALTIME via cert proxy but MTK mid-tier gets only 'likely'. GMS fine.
